title: haagea dipetala
intro: Haagea dipetala, commonly known as the evening primrose, is a flowering plant species in the family Onagraceae. The evening primrose has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce the risk of heart disease, and support skin health. The therapeutic actions of Haagea dipetala include its ability to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it a popular natural remedy for stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of the evening primrose include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), a polyunsaturated fatty acid with anti-inflammatory properties.
